title: Robe of the Weave
summary: Gain +2 AC, +1 spell attacks and spell save DC, and heal on successful spell saves.

fields.Arcane Enchantment: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
fields.Weave Eater: Regain 1d6 HP on a successful saving throw against a spell.
fields.Acquisition: Inside a globe at Ramazith’s Tower, X 4970, Y 705. See Invisibility reveals its lever. Each character can try DC 20 Arcana once. A failed attempt triggers a trap.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
